productConcept.name: Griting
productConcept.tagline: Talent Trust and Readiness Infrastructure for the AI Capital
productConcept.description: An enterprise platform that verifies AI-era talent capability through auditable assessments, structured incubation, and AI-powered global mentorship.
productConcept.rationale: Content-derived: product name, tagline, and all section copy drawn verbatim from provided Figma content object. Design system aesthetic — monochromatic deep forest green, Plus Jakarta Sans with 0.06em tracking, measured GSAP animations — aligns with enterprise infrastructure positioning.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — GSAP and ScrollTrigger referenced in motion.json libraries array, named easing curves present (cubic-bezier), concept_by_video.md describes fadeInUp cascades and staggered card entry; recommendations also explicitly request GSAP + ScrollTrigger
backgroundAlternation: dark (hero) → light (about) → dark (ecosystem) → light (audit + incubation + mentorship) → dark (expanding) → light (testimonials) → dark (cta + footer)
assetsStrategy: CSS gradients throughout — radial gradients on hero/cta, grid overlay on expanding section, directional gradient accents on cards. No external image/video assets required — palette-consistent depth via CSS only.
imageGenerationStatus: not-needed — all visual depth via CSS gradients per design system and recommendations

designDecisions.fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans (headings, buttons, labels) + Inter (body, nav, captions) — both from Google Fonts CDN
designDecisions.letterSpacing: 0.06em on headings, 0.08em on nav links — from nav-system token characterDescription
designDecisions.cardSurface: #0D3B1C on dark sections, #FFFFFF on light sections — from interactions.json card default states
designDecisions.navBehavior: Fixed 72px → 60px on scroll with backdrop-filter blur(12px) and 1px border-bottom — from nav-system tokens
designDecisions.testimonialCarousel: CSS infinite scroll animation (40s linear) with hover-pause, duplicated set for seamless loop
designDecisions.expandingSection: Subtle grid background via CSS background-image + mask-image for depth without external assets
